name: Doodh Patti Chai
description: Rich Pakistani doodh patti made by simmering black tea with milk, sugar and optional cardamom for a strong, comforting cup.
ingredients: 2 to 3 tsp sugar, or to taste
2 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed, optional
method: Add the milk to a saucepan with the optional water and cardamom, and heat gently while watching closely so it does not boil over.
Add the black tea leaves and sugar once the liquid is hot, then stir to dissolve the sugar.
Bring the chai to a controlled boil, lower the heat and simmer briefly until the colour deepens and the tea strength suits you.
Avoid extending the boil excessively to force a darker colour, as prolonged brewing can make the tea harsh.
Strain directly into cups and serve hot. Adjust tea quantity or simmering time on the next batch if you prefer a stronger or lighter doodh patti.
